## Context
The hourly host updater `/Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar-dev-update.sh` installs a Git URL through pipx. Commit `4214516f95` made the repository uv-lock-canonical and declared the `eval`+`dev` extra combination incompatible; commit `31844d5f9f` correctly overrides Inspect AI's stale `click<8.2.2` cap and locks Click 8.4.2 to remediate PYSEC-2026-2132. The override is workspace-only and is not published in wheel metadata. The updater therefore bypasses both the committed lock and the Click override, and its 2026-08-04 01:27 run failed unlocked resolution while leaving the global host runtime stale at `d72c4777`. This blocks A2-2 and later A6-1 rollout evidence.

## Approach
- Preserve `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, the Click override, and all dependency declarations unchanged.
- Replace the pipx VCS-resolution step with an exact-SHA, versioned local checkout under the updater state directory and `uv sync --locked`.
- Sync the runtime/operator extras `mcp`, `reviewbot`, `ui`, `agents`, `eval`, `tracing`, `grounding`, and `grounding-t2` with `--no-dev`. Development tools are intentionally excluded from the global runtime; `eval` remains available, and the declared `eval`+`dev` conflict is respected.
- Retain the existing single-flight directory lock. Build and smoke-test an unpublished candidate. A rejected candidate logs `candidate <sha> rejected at <stage>`, exits nonzero, and leaves the current pointer untouched.
- Make `/Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar`, `rebar-mcp`, and `last-good.sha` stable links through one updater-managed `current` symlink. Each release contains its `.venv` and a `sha` file. Publication stages `current.new` and atomically renames that one symlink to `current`; the two executables and checkpoint therefore switch at one filesystem commit point. One-time migration establishes the stable links before scheduled publication and verifies all three resolve through `current`.
- After successful publication retain only the published release; remove rejected candidates and superseded releases so hourly updates cannot grow the state directory without bound.
- Trigger the updater through launchd and verify an immediately following no-op.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The updater checks out the exact SHA returned by `git ls-remote`. Tier: deterministic script-content check.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The updater runs `uv sync --locked` inside that exact-SHA checkout. Tier: deterministic script-content check.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The sync requests `mcp`, `reviewbot`, `ui`, `agents`, `eval`, `tracing`, `grounding`, and `grounding-t2` with `--no-dev`. Tier: deterministic script-content check.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The script change does not modify repository `pyproject.toml` or `uv.lock`. Tier: repository diff check.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An injected sync failure logs `candidate <sha> rejected at sync` and exits nonzero. Tier: disposable-state failure probe.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An injected sync failure leaves `current` byte-identical. Tier: disposable-state failure probe.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An injected smoke failure logs `candidate <sha> rejected at smoke` and exits nonzero. Tier: disposable-state failure probe.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An injected smoke failure leaves `current` byte-identical. Tier: disposable-state failure probe.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Crash probes immediately before and after the `current` rename observe either all-old or all-new resolution for `rebar`, `rebar-mcp`, and `last-good.sha`, never a mixed tuple. Tier: disposable-state publish-boundary probe.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] After successful publication, only the published release directory remains under updater-managed releases. Tier: disposable-state success probe.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A launchd-triggered real install exits 0 and advances `last-good.sha` to the exact `origin/main` SHA used for the run.
- [ ] [operator-attested] `/Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar` resolves through `current` into the versioned exact-SHA runtime.
- [ ] [operator-attested] `/Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar-mcp` resolves through `current` into the same versioned exact-SHA runtime.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The published runtime reports Click 8.4.2.
- [ ] [operator-attested] `pip-audit` reports no PYSEC-2026-2132 finding for the published runtime.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The published global build loads this repository's effective criteria without a configuration error.
- [ ] [operator-attested] `rebar --help` exits 0 against the published runtime.
- [ ] [operator-attested] `rebar list --help` exits 0 against the published runtime.
- [ ] [operator-attested] An immediately following launchd run logs `no change (already on <installed-sha>)` and exits 0.

## Files
Machine-local `/Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar-dev-update.sh` and updater-managed state under `/Users/joeoakhart/.local/state/rebar-dev/`; no repository files.

Scope: S. Discovered while collecting A2-2 rollout evidence.
